assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient reports intermittent episodes of palpitations.
The palpitations are accompanied by dizziness and giddiness.
The telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
The telemetry is ordered to assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease.
The service was denied under CO-50.
The clinical indication explicitly supports the need to evaluate these specific symptoms against the patient's cardiac history.
